provenance_warning: Genuine/unknown samples include third-party receipts found on Facebook/Scribd/Instagram. NEVER use those as the GENUINE class - internet receipts are disproportionately fraudulent, and contaminated labels produce a confident wrong model. Use them as SUSPECT examples only. Build the genuine class from your own transactions and written consent. Captions/watermarks are in the pixels: never feed them as evidence in production.

samples.amount_in_words: Four Million Nine Hundred Fifty Thousand Naira Zero Kobo Only
samples.note: Date matches exactly. Embedded 11:58:54 vs printed 10:54 GMT+0 = 4.9 min. That is PLAUSIBLE initiation-vs-settlement lag, NOT proof of forgery - I explicitly refused to call it fake on a 5-minute gap. Amount-in-words consistent. Remark repeats the reference verbatim (a check that passed). N4.95M from 'ONLINE PHOTO CONTEST' style framing = prize-scam context, which is a SEMANTIC signal, not arithmetic.

THE HARDEST LESSON: this reference is internally PERFECT. It may be a real payment. The fraud is the CONTEXT (advance-fee prize scam). A detector built only on format will always miss this. Semantic/behavioural signals (generic sender name, prize remark, large round amount to a personal account, receipt shared publicly as 'evidence') belong in the reviewer queue, never as an automatic verdict.
